qa_pair.question: Which networking topology and protocol version are shipped?
qa_pair.answer: client-server using zvibe-gameplay version 1 over authenticated WebSocket

qa_pair.question: Are host, join, or reconnect credentials persisted in the scene configuration or returned by retained runtime status? Respond True or False.
Which two authority modes can a Network Replication component author?
Which prediction correction behaviors are implemented?
Which five deterministic adverse-network controls are available per player?
qa_pair.answer: latency, jitter, packet loss, packet reorder, seed

qa_pair.question: How many local players can Multiplayer Play Mode run?
Does each additional Multiplayer Play player use a separate compiled scene and engine? Respond True or False.
What exact values lease authored networking, transient lobby, and Multiplayer Play control mutations?
qa_pair.answer: configuration revision, session revision, run revision

qa_pair.question: Does the browser transport claim Unity Transport protocol identity or raw UDP/DTLS unreliable datagrams? Respond True or False.

qa_pair.answer: confirm=true and a trusted network or external TLS terminator
